items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: sometimes I used to play bass with them, too... it was just about three or four pieces, or five pieces, I think it was Walter Preston, Tom Brown, uh, Charlie Washington

ctx.x: Did you ever hit, you played guitar with him then? Yeah.

Madeline, most I played with Madeline Lee, you see. He'd have a guitar, I had Walter, uh, Walter of, uh, let's see, what Walter's name was. Been so long now. I know Walter, his name was Walter, guitar player. And he could sing too, you see. Him and Walter would sing and, uh, but he'd do all the rhyming. And I'd, I'd just play a lead part, anything he wanted to sing, I could play the lead part, you see, on a mandolin. Uh, he made, he was a hustler and he made, you go with him like a knight, when he get through the…
Did you know that song about Maestri's wagons been here until?
